examples.src: Hurdling requires speed and good technique.
examples.dst: 跨栏需要速度和良好的技术。

examples.src: He won a medal in hurdling at the school games.
examples.dst: 他在校运会的跨栏项目中获得了奖牌。

examples.src: She practises hurdling every afternoon.
examples.dst: 她每天下午练习跨栏。

confuse.diff: hurdling 指跨栏；hurtling 指高速猛冲。

examples.src: Boxing is a tough sport that needs strong discipline.
examples.dst: 拳击是一项需要严格自律的艰苦运动。

examples.src: My brother has taken up boxing to keep fit.
examples.dst: 我哥哥开始练拳击来保持健康。

examples.src: The boxing match attracted thousands of fans.
examples.dst: 这场拳击比赛吸引了成千上万的球迷。

confuse.diff: boxing 是拳击运动；boxer 指拳击手。

examples.src: Hula hooping is a fun way to exercise your waist.
examples.dst: 玩呼啦圈是锻炼腰部的有趣方式。

examples.src: They held a hula hooping contest at the party.
examples.dst: 他们在聚会上举办了呼啦圈比赛。

examples.src: She is good at hula hooping and can keep going for ten minutes.
examples.dst: 她很擅长转呼啦圈，能连续转十分钟。

means: 弹簧单高跷跳；跳跳杆运动

examples.src: Pogo stick jumping tests your balance and strength.
examples.dst: 玩跳跳杆考验你的平衡力和力量。

examples.src: He set a record in pogo stick jumping.
examples.dst: 他在跳跳杆项目中创下了纪录。

examples.src: Children enjoy pogo stick jumping in the park.
examples.dst: 孩子们喜欢在公园里玩跳跳杆。

examples.src: We did twenty jumping jacks to warm up.
examples.dst: 我们做了二十个开合跳来热身。

examples.src: Jumping jacks are a simple full-body exercise.
examples.dst: 开合跳是一种简单的全身运动。

examples.src: The coach asked us to do jumping jacks before the run.
examples.dst: 教练让我们在跑步前做开合跳。

examples.src: Somersaulting needs courage and practice.
examples.dst: 翻筋斗需要勇气和练习。

examples.src: The little boy loves somersaulting on the grass.
examples.dst: 小男孩喜欢在草地上翻筋斗。

examples.src: She learned somersaulting in her gymnastics class.
examples.dst: 她在体操课上学会了翻筋斗。

examples.src: Do ten lunges on each leg.
examples.dst: 每条腿做十个弓步。

examples.src: The goalkeeper lunged for the ball.
examples.dst: 守门员向球扑去。

examples.src: He made a lunge at the thief but missed.
examples.dst: 他朝小偷猛扑过去，却没抓到。

confuse.diff: lunge 指向前猛冲；plunge 指猛然跳入或骤降。

means: 吉尼斯（世界纪录）；健力士（啤酒品牌）

examples.src: He hopes to break a Guinness World Record.
examples.dst: 他希望打破吉尼斯世界纪录。

examples.src: The Guinness book lists many amazing records.
examples.dst: 吉尼斯纪录大全收录了许多惊人的纪录。

examples.src: She entered the Guinness record book for her long jump.
examples.dst: 她因跳远成绩被载入吉尼斯纪录。

examples.src: The approximate cost of the trip is 2,000 yuan.
examples.dst: 这次旅行的大致费用是两千元。

examples.src: Give me an approximate answer first.
examples.dst: 先给我一个大概的答案。

examples.src: Her estimate approximates the real figure.
examples.dst: 她的估算接近实际数字。

confuse.diff: approximate 指大约的；appropriate 指适当的。

examples.src: The journey takes approximately two hours.
examples.dst: 这段路程大约需要两个小时。

examples.src: Approximately 500 students attended the meeting.
examples.dst: 大约有五百名学生参加了会议。

examples.src: The lake is approximately ten metres deep.
examples.dst: 这个湖大约十米深。

confuse.diff: approximately 指大约；appropriately 指恰当地。

examples.src: She prefers conventional methods of teaching.
examples.dst: 她更喜欢传统的教学方法。

examples.src: The design is far from conventional.
examples.dst: 这个设计一点也不传统。

examples.src: Conventional medicine does not work for everyone.
examples.dst: 常规药物并非对每个人都有效。

confuse.diff: conventional 指传统的；convenient 指方便的。

examples.src: The room was filled with laughter.
examples.dst: 房间里充满了笑声。

examples.src: Laughter is the best medicine.
examples.dst: 笑是最好的良药。

examples.src: She burst into laughter when she heard the joke.
examples.dst: 听到这个笑话，她大笑起来。

confuse.diff: laughter 指笑声；slaughter 指屠杀。

examples.src: You have to face reality.
examples.dst: 你必须面对现实。

examples.src: His dream finally became a reality.
examples.dst: 他的梦想终于成为现实。

examples.src: Reality is often different from what we imagine.
examples.dst: 现实往往和我们想象的不同。

confuse.diff: reality 指现实；realty 指不动产。

examples.src: He looks calm, but in reality he is very nervous.
examples.dst: 他看起来很平静，但实际上非常紧张。

examples.src: In reality, the task was much harder than we thought.
examples.dst: 实际上，这项任务比我们想的难得多。

examples.src: The story seems simple, but in reality it is quite complex.
examples.dst: 这个故事看似简单，实际上相当复杂。

means: 调整；调节；适应（常拼作 adjustment）

examples.src: The plan needs some adjustment.
examples.dst: 这个计划需要做一些调整。

examples.src: It took him a while to make the adjustment to city life.
examples.dst: 他花了一段时间才适应城市生活。

examples.src: A small adjustment to the seat made it more comfortable.
examples.dst: 稍微调整一下座位，就舒服多了。

confuse.diff: ajustment 是常见拼写错误；正确拼写为 adjustment。

means: 艰难的；坚强的；严厉的；坚韧的

examples.src: It was a tough decision to make.
examples.dst: 这是一个艰难的决定。

examples.src: She is tough enough to deal with any problem.
examples.dst: 她足够坚强，能应对任何问题。

examples.src: The meat was too tough to chew.
examples.dst: 这肉太老，嚼不动。

confuse.diff: tough 指艰难的；though 指虽然。
tough 是形容词；through 是介词，意为穿过。

examples.src: The desert has extreme heat in summer.
examples.dst: 沙漠夏季极其炎热。

examples.src: He took extreme care of the old books.
examples.dst: 他极其小心地保管这些旧书。

examples.src: Don't go to extremes when you diet.
examples.dst: 节食时不要走极端。

confuse.diff: extreme 是形容词；extremely 是副词，意为极其。

examples.src: The child felt sick and began to vomit.
examples.dst: 孩子觉得恶心，开始呕吐。

examples.src: Some people vomit on long bus rides.
examples.dst: 有些人坐长途汽车会呕吐。

examples.src: The smell made him want to vomit.
examples.dst: 这气味让他想吐。

examples.src: She has been learning gymnastics since she was six.
examples.dst: 她从六岁起就开始学体操。

examples.src: Gymnastics improves balance and flexibility.
examples.dst: 体操能提高平衡力和柔韧性。

examples.src: He won a gold medal in gymnastics.
examples.dst: 他在体操比赛中赢得了金牌。

confuse.diff: gymnastics 指体操；gymnasium 指体育馆。

examples.src: The girl moved gymnastically across the beam.
examples.dst: 女孩像体操运动员一样在平衡木上移动。

examples.src: He is gymnastically gifted.
examples.dst: 他在体操方面很有天赋。

examples.src: The cat jumped gymnastically from branch to branch.
examples.dst: 那只猫像体操运动员一样在树枝间跳跃。

confuse.diff: gymnastically 是副词；gymnastics 是名词，指体操。

means: 不健康的；不适合的；不称职的

examples.src: I felt unfit after months without exercise.
examples.dst: 几个月没运动，我觉得身体状态很差。

examples.src: The water is unfit to drink.
examples.dst: 这水不适合饮用。

examples.src: He was judged unfit for the job.
examples.dst: 他被认为不适合这份工作。

confuse.diff: unfit 指不适合或不健康；unfair 指不公平。

examples.src: Stories about space fascinate many children.
examples.dst: 关于太空的故事让许多孩子着迷。

examples.src: The magician's tricks fascinated the audience.
examples.dst: 魔术师的戏法让观众着迷。

examples.src: Ancient history has always fascinated me.
examples.dst: 古代历史一直令我着迷。

confuse.diff: fascinate 是动词；fascinating 是形容词，意为迷人的。

examples.src: She spends ten minutes on meditation every morning.
examples.dst: 她每天早上花十分钟冥想。

examples.src: Meditation can help you relax.
examples.dst: 冥想可以帮助你放松。

examples.src: He was lost in deep meditation.
examples.dst: 他陷入了深深的沉思。

confuse.diff: meditation 指冥想；medication 指药物。

examples.src: Music gives her great spiritual comfort.
examples.dst: 音乐给了她极大的精神慰藉。

examples.src: Many people seek spiritual growth through meditation.
examples.dst: 许多人通过冥想寻求心灵成长。

examples.src: The monk lives a simple spiritual life.
examples.dst: 这位僧人过着简朴的精神生活。

confuse.diff: spiritual 指精神的；spirited 指活泼有精神的。

means: 马拉松；耐力比赛；持久的活动

examples.src: He ran his first marathon last spring.
examples.dst: 他去年春天跑了人生第一个马拉松。

examples.src: The marathon starts at the city square.
examples.dst: 马拉松比赛从市中心广场出发。

examples.src: Studying for the exam was a real marathon.
examples.dst: 备考真是一场持久战。

examples.src: The teacher urged us to read more books.
examples.dst: 老师敦促我们多读书。

examples.src: She felt a strong urge to cry.
examples.dst: 她有一股强烈想哭的冲动。

examples.src: Doctors urge people to quit smoking.
examples.dst: 医生力劝人们戒烟。

confuse.diff: urge 是动词，指敦促；urgent 是形容词，指紧急的。

examples.src: We accomplished the task ahead of time.
examples.dst: 我们提前完成了任务。

examples.src: She accomplished her dream of becoming a doctor.
examples.dst: 她实现了成为医生的梦想。

examples.src: What do you hope to accomplish this year?
examples.dst: 你今年希望完成什么？

confuse.diff: accomplish 指完成；accompany 指陪伴。

examples.src: He lacks the motivation to study.
examples.dst: 他缺乏学习的动力。

examples.src: Praise can be a strong motivation for children.
examples.dst: 表扬对孩子来说可以是很强的动力。

examples.src: What is your motivation for joining the club?
examples.dst: 你加入这个社团的动机是什么？

confuse.diff: motivation 指动力或积极性；motive 指具体的动机或目的。

examples.src: The nurse is known for her devotion to her patients.
examples.dst: 这位护士以对病人的全心奉献而闻名。

examples.src: His devotion to music began in childhood.
examples.dst: 他从小就热爱音乐。

examples.src: They admired the teacher's devotion to education.
examples.dst: 他们钦佩这位老师对教育事业的奉献。

confuse.diff: devotion 指奉献；devotee 指狂热爱好者。

examples.src: Music touches the soul.
examples.dst: 音乐触动心灵。

examples.src: Not a soul was in the street.
examples.dst: 街上一个人影也没有。

examples.src: She put her heart and soul into the project.
examples.dst: 她全身心投入到这个项目中。

confuse.diff: soul 指灵魂；sole 指唯一的或脚底。

examples.src: The mountain is sacred to local people.
examples.dst: 这座山对当地人来说是神圣的。

examples.src: Freedom of speech is considered sacred.
examples.dst: 言论自由被视为神圣不可侵犯。

examples.src: They visited a sacred temple in the north.
examples.dst: 他们参观了北方的一座圣庙。

confuse.diff: sacred 指神圣的；scared 指害怕的。

examples.src: A good deed is never wasted.
examples.dst: 善行从不会白费。

examples.src: He is judged by his deeds, not his words.
examples.dst: 人们根据他的行为而不是言语来评价他。

examples.src: She did a brave deed and saved the child.
examples.dst: 她做了一件勇敢的事，救了那个孩子。

confuse.diff: deed 指行为；indeed 是副词，意为确实。

examples.src: He has a clear conception of what he wants to do.
examples.dst: 他清楚自己想做什么。

examples.src: Her conception of friendship is very simple.
examples.dst: 她对友谊的理解很简单。

examples.src: The idea was a bold conception at the time.
examples.dst: 这个想法在当时是一个大胆的构想。

confuse.diff: conception 指构想或概念；perception 指感知。

examples.src: She handled the problem with great tact.
examples.dst: 她非常得体地处理了这个问题。

examples.src: It takes tact to refuse an invitation politely.
examples.dst: 礼貌地拒绝邀请需要圆通。

examples.src: He lacks tact and often upsets people.
examples.dst: 他不够圆滑，常常惹人不快。

confuse.diff: tact 指得体的处事能力；tactic 指策略。

examples.src: I regret not studying harder last term.
examples.dst: 我后悔上学期没有更用功。

examples.src: She expressed deep regret for her mistake.
examples.dst: 她对自己的错误深表歉意。

examples.src: We regret to inform you that the flight is cancelled.
examples.dst: 我们遗憾地通知您，航班已取消。

confuse.diff: regret 指后悔；regard 指看待或尊重。

examples.src: He showed true repentance for his crime.
examples.dst: 他对自己的罪行表示了真诚的悔悟。

examples.src: Repentance is the first step to change.
examples.dst: 悔悟是改变的第一步。

examples.src: Her tears were a sign of repentance.
examples.dst: 她的眼泪是悔悟的表现。

confuse.diff: repentance 是名词；repentant 是形容词，意为悔过的。

examples.src: Wisdom comes with age and experience.
examples.dst: 智慧随着年龄和经验而增长。

examples.src: The old man is known for his wisdom.
examples.dst: 这位老人以智慧闻名。

examples.src: It was not wise to ignore her wisdom.
examples.dst: 无视她的智慧是不明智的。

confuse.diff: wisdom 是名词，指智慧；wise 是形容词，指明智的。

examples.src: Honesty is a great virtue.
examples.dst: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。

examples.src: Patience is one of her many virtues.
examples.dst: 耐心是她众多优点之一。

examples.src: There is no virtue in being late.
examples.dst: 迟到没有任何可取之处。

confuse.diff: virtue 指美德；virtual 指虚拟的。

examples.src: Teaching is a noble profession.
examples.dst: 教师是一个崇高的职业。

examples.src: He came from a noble family.
examples.dst: 他出身贵族家庭。

examples.src: It was a noble act to give up his seat.
examples.dst: 他让座的行为十分高尚。

confuse.diff: noble 指高尚的；Nobel 是诺贝尔（人名或奖项）。

examples.src: The plan was doomed to fail.
examples.dst: 这个计划注定要失败。

examples.src: They faced certain doom in the storm.
examples.dst: 他们在风暴中面临必死的厄运。

examples.src: A sense of doom filled the room.
examples.dst: 一种大难临头的感觉笼罩着房间。

confuse.diff: doom 指厄运；gloom 指忧郁或昏暗。

examples.src: He bid 500 dollars for the painting.
examples.dst: 他为这幅画出价五百美元。

examples.src: The city made a bid to host the Olympics.
examples.dst: 这座城市申办奥运会。

examples.src: We bid farewell to our teachers.
examples.dst: 我们向老师们告别。

confuse.diff: bid 指出价；bind 指捆绑。

examples.src: The clown can juggle five balls at once.
examples.dst: 小丑能同时抛接五个球。

examples.src: She juggles work and family life.
examples.dst: 她兼顾工作与家庭生活。

examples.src: Students often have to juggle study and hobbies.
examples.dst: 学生常常要兼顾学习和爱好。

confuse.diff: juggle 是动词；juggler 指杂耍艺人。

examples.src: A triathlon includes swimming, cycling and running.
examples.dst: 铁人三项包括游泳、骑行和跑步。

examples.src: He trained for a year to enter the triathlon.
examples.dst: 他训练了一年才参加铁人三项赛。

examples.src: The triathlon will be held by the sea.
examples.dst: 铁人三项赛将在海边举行。

confuse.diff: triathlon 是三项全能；decathlon 是十项全能。

examples.src: The triathlete finished the race in under two hours.
examples.dst: 这位铁人三项运动员不到两小时就完成了比赛。

examples.src: Triathletes need strong endurance.
examples.dst: 铁人三项运动员需要很强的耐力。

examples.src: She dreams of becoming a professional triathlete.
examples.dst: 她梦想成为职业铁人三项运动员。

confuse.diff: triathlete 专指铁人三项选手；athlete 指运动员。

examples.src: He is an amateur photographer.
examples.dst: 他是一名业余摄影师。

examples.src: Amateur players joined the football match.
examples.dst: 业余球员参加了这场足球赛。

examples.src: The work looks rather amateur.
examples.dst: 这件作品看起来相当外行。

examples.src: She became the world champion at nineteen.
examples.dst: 她十九岁就成了世界冠军。

examples.src: He is a champion of human rights.
examples.dst: 他是人权的捍卫者。

examples.src: Our school team is the city champion.
examples.dst: 我们学校的队伍是全市冠军。

confuse.diff: champion 指冠军；championship 指锦标赛或冠军称号。

examples.src: It rained heavily; therefore, the match was cancelled.
examples.dst: 雨下得很大，因此比赛取消了。

examples.src: He was ill and therefore could not come.
examples.dst: 他生病了，所以不能来。

examples.src: I think, therefore I am.
examples.dst: 我思故我在。

confuse.diff: therefore 意为因此；therefor 是较罕见的词，意为为此。

examples.src: The diver jumped off the springboard.
examples.dst: 跳水运动员从跳板上跳下。

examples.src: The job was a springboard to a successful career.
examples.dst: 这份工作是通往成功事业的跳板。

examples.src: Use this success as a springboard for the future.
examples.dst: 把这次成功作为迈向未来的起点。

examples.src: She studies economics at university.
examples.dst: 她在大学里学习经济学。

examples.src: The economics of the project are not clear.
examples.dst: 这个项目的经济状况还不明朗。

examples.src: Economics explains how people use limited resources.
examples.dst: 经济学解释人们如何使用有限的资源。

confuse.diff: economics 指经济学；economy 指经济体或节约。

examples.src: She spent the entire day reading.
examples.dst: 她整天都在读书。

examples.src: The entire class passed the test.
examples.dst: 全班同学都通过了测验。

examples.src: I read the entire book in one night.
examples.dst: 我一晚上就读完了整本书。

confuse.diff: entire 是形容词；entirely 是副词，意为完全地。

examples.src: He attained his goal after years of effort.
examples.dst: 经过多年努力，他达成了目标。

examples.src: She attained a high score in the exam.
examples.dst: 她在考试中取得了高分。

examples.src: It is hard to attain perfection.
examples.dst: 完美很难达到。

confuse.diff: attain 强调通过努力达到目标；obtain 指获得具体的东西。

examples.src: The photo shows her profile.
examples.dst: 这张照片拍的是她的侧脸。

examples.src: Please update your profile on the website.
examples.dst: 请在网站上更新你的个人资料。

examples.src: The company wants to raise its public profile.
examples.dst: 这家公司想提高自己的公众形象。

confuse.diff: profile 指轮廓或简介；prophecy 指预言。

examples.src: The courageous boy saved his friend from the river.
examples.dst: 那个勇敢的男孩把朋友从河里救了出来。

examples.src: It was a courageous decision to speak out.
examples.dst: 站出来说话是一个勇敢的决定。

examples.src: She is a courageous leader.
examples.dst: 她是一位有胆识的领导者。

confuse.diff: courageous 指勇敢的；courteous 指有礼貌的。

examples.src: I really appreciate your help.
examples.dst: 我真的很感激你的帮助。

examples.src: She appreciates good music.
examples.dst: 她懂得欣赏好音乐。

examples.src: We appreciate the difficulty of the task.
examples.dst: 我们认识到这项任务的难度。

confuse.diff: appreciate 是动词；appreciation 是名词，指感激或欣赏。

examples.src: She sent a card to show her appreciation.
examples.dst: 她寄了一张卡片表示感谢。

examples.src: He has a deep appreciation of art.
examples.dst: 他对艺术有很深的鉴赏力。

examples.src: We clapped in appreciation of the performance.
examples.dst: 我们鼓掌欣赏这场演出。

confuse.diff: appreciation 是名词；appreciate 是动词，指感激。

examples.src: My uncle works as an accountant in a bank.
examples.dst: 我叔叔在银行当会计。

examples.src: The accountant checked the company's accounts.

confuse.diff: reservation 是名词，指预订；reserve 是动词，指预留。

examples.src: The highway runs along the coast.
examples.dst: 这条公路沿着海岸延伸。

examples.src: There was a traffic jam on the highway.
examples.dst: 公路上发生了交通堵塞。

examples.src: They drove for hours on the highway.
examples.dst: 他们在公路上开了好几个小时的车。

confuse.diff: highway 指公路；hallway 指走廊。

examples.src: The baby slept in a wooden cradle.
examples.dst: 婴儿睡在木制摇篮里。

examples.src: The Yellow River is the cradle of Chinese civilization.
examples.dst: 黄河是中华文明的发源地。

examples.src: She cradled the kitten in her arms.
examples.dst: 她把小猫轻轻抱在怀里。

confuse.diff: cradle 指摇篮；candle 指蜡烛。

examples.src: The region has heavy rainfall in summer.
examples.dst: 这个地区夏季降雨量很大。

examples.src: Annual rainfall is about 800 millimetres.
examples.dst: 年降雨量约为八百毫米。

examples.src: Low rainfall caused a shortage of water.
examples.dst: 降雨量偏少造成了缺水。

confuse.diff: rainfall 指降雨量；snowfall 指降雪量。

examples.src: Agriculture is important to the economy of this country.
examples.dst: 农业对这个国家的经济很重要。

examples.src: Modern agriculture uses many machines.
examples.dst: 现代农业使用许多机器。

examples.src: He studied agriculture at university.
examples.dst: 他在大学里学农学。

confuse.diff: agriculture 是名词；agricultural 是形容词，指农业的。

examples.src: Farmers sow wheat in the autumn.
examples.dst: 农民在秋天播种小麦。

examples.src: He sowed the seeds in the garden.
examples.dst: 他在花园里播下了种子。

examples.src: The rumour sowed doubt among the people.
examples.dst: 这个谣言在人们中间埋下了疑虑。

confuse.diff: sow 指播种；sew 指缝纫，二者读音相近。

examples.src: He remained a bachelor all his life.
examples.dst: 他终身未婚。

examples.src: She has a bachelor's degree in biology.
examples.dst: 她有生物学学士学位。

examples.src: The bachelor lived alone in a small flat.
examples.dst: 这位单身汉独自住在一间小公寓里。

examples.src: His story does not correspond with the facts.
examples.dst: 他的说法与事实不符。

examples.src: The two friends corresponded for many years.
examples.dst: 这两个朋友通信多年。

examples.src: The word in French corresponds to the English one.
examples.dst: 这个法语词与那个英语词相对应。

confuse.diff: correspond 是动词；correspondence 是名词，指通信或一致。

examples.src: The results correspond with our predictions.
examples.dst: 结果与我们的预测相符。

examples.src: She corresponds with a pen friend in Canada.
examples.dst: 她和一位加拿大笔友通信。

examples.src: His account does not correspond with what I saw.
examples.dst: 他的描述与我看到的不符。

means: 欠；应归功于；对……负有义务

examples.src: I owe my friend fifty yuan.
examples.dst: 我欠朋友五十元。

examples.src: We owe our parents a great deal.
examples.dst: 我们受父母的恩惠很多。

examples.src: She owes her success to hard work.
examples.dst: 她的成功归功于努力。

confuse.diff: owe 指欠；own 指拥有。

examples.src: He owes his life to the doctor.
examples.dst: 他的命是医生救的。

examples.src: I owe my success to my teachers.
examples.dst: 我把成功归功于我的老师们。

examples.src: She owes a lot of money to the bank.
examples.dst: 她欠银行很多钱。

confuse.diff: owe to 指归功于或欠；owing to 是介词短语，意为由于。

examples.src: The zoo has a large enclosure for the elephants.
examples.dst: 动物园为大象准备了一个大围场。

examples.src: I put a photo in the enclosure of the letter.
examples.dst: 我在信里附了一张照片。

examples.src: The sheep stayed inside the enclosure.
examples.dst: 羊群留在围栏里。

confuse.diff: enclosure 是名词；enclose 是动词，指围住或附上。

examples.src: The local authorities closed the road.
examples.dst: 地方当局封闭了这条路。

examples.src: Teachers have the authority to keep order in class.
examples.dst: 教师有权维持课堂秩序。

examples.src: She is an authority on ancient history.
examples.dst: 她是古代史方面的权威。

confuse.diff: authority 是名词，指权力；authorize 是动词，指授权。

means: 绝望的；不顾一切的；极需的

examples.src: The lost hikers were desperate for water.
examples.dst: 迷路的徒步者极度渴望水。

examples.src: He made a desperate attempt to save his friend.
examples.dst: 他拼命想救自己的朋友。

examples.src: She felt desperate when she failed again.
examples.dst: 再次失败时，她感到绝望。

confuse.diff: desperate 指绝望的；separate 指分开的。

examples.src: My sweater shrank in the wash.
examples.dst: 我的毛衣洗后缩水了。

examples.src: The forest has shrunk over the years.
examples.dst: 这片森林多年来不断缩小。

examples.src: He shrank back in fear.
examples.dst: 他吓得往后退缩。

confuse.diff: shrink 指收缩；shrine 指神龛或圣地。

examples.src: We had a barbecue in the garden on Sunday.
examples.dst: 星期天我们在花园里办了一场烧烤。

examples.src: He barbecued some chicken wings.
examples.dst: 他烤了一些鸡翅。

examples.src: The barbecue smelled delicious.
examples.dst: 烧烤的味道很香。

examples.src: She talked me into joining the choir.
examples.dst: 她说服我加入了合唱团。

examples.src: Don't let them talk you into buying that.
examples.dst: 别让他们说服你买那个东西。

examples.src: I finally talked my parents into letting me go.
examples.dst: 我终于说服父母让我去了。

confuse.diff: talk into 是说服去做；talk out of 是劝阻不做。

examples.src: The river winds through the valley.
examples.dst: 河流蜿蜒穿过山谷。

examples.src: She wound the scarf around her neck.
examples.dst: 她把围巾绕在脖子上。

examples.src: A cold wind blew from the north.
examples.dst: 一阵冷风从北方吹来。

confuse.diff: wind 的过去式是 wound /waʊnd/；wound 作名词读 /wuːnd/，指伤口。

examples.src: He broke a limb in the accident.
examples.dst: 他在事故中摔断了一条胳膊或腿。

examples.src: The cat climbed out onto a limb of the tree.
examples.dst: 猫爬到了树的一根大枝上。

examples.src: Stretch your limbs before you exercise.
examples.dst: 运动前先伸展一下四肢。

confuse.diff: limb 指肢；limp 指跛行或软绵绵的。

examples.src: The snake's venom can kill a person.
examples.dst: 这条蛇的毒液可以致人死亡。

examples.src: He spoke with venom about his former boss.
examples.dst: 他满怀怨恨地谈到自己的前老板。

examples.src: Scientists study the venom of spiders.
examples.dst: 科学家研究蜘蛛的毒液。

confuse.diff: venom 指毒液；vanish 指消失。

examples.src: Some snakes are venomous.
examples.dst: 有些蛇是有毒的。

examples.src: Be careful, that spider is venomous.
examples.dst: 小心，那只蜘蛛有毒。

examples.src: He gave her a venomous look.
examples.dst: 他恶狠狠地瞪了她一眼。

confuse.diff: venomous 指通过咬或刺注入毒液；poisonous 指吃进去或接触会中毒。

examples.src: The doctor gave him anti-venom after the snake bite.
examples.dst: 被蛇咬后，医生给他注射了抗蛇毒血清。

examples.src: Anti-venom saves many lives every year.
examples.dst: 抗蛇毒血清每��挽救许多生命。

examples.src: The hospital keeps a supply of anti-venom.
examples.dst: 这家医院储备有抗蛇毒血清。

means: 使瘫痪；使麻痹；使无法正常运转

examples.src: The accident paralyzed his legs.
examples.dst: 这次事故使他的双腿瘫痪了。

examples.src: Fear paralyzed her and she could not speak.
examples.dst: 恐惧使她动弹不得，说不出话来。

examples.src: The snowstorm paralyzed the city's traffic.
examples.dst: 暴风雪使这座城市的交通陷入瘫痪。

confuse.diff: paralyze 指使瘫痪；analyze 指分析。

examples.src: He missed school because of sickness.
examples.dst: 他因生病没去上学。

examples.src: Sea sickness made her feel terrible.
examples.dst: 晕船让她感觉很难受。

examples.src: The village was hit by a strange sickness.
examples.dst: 这个村子遭受了一种怪病的侵袭。

confuse.diff: sickness 是名词，指疾病；sickly 是形容词，指多病的。

examples.src: She is slowly recovering from the flu.
examples.dst: 她正从流感中慢慢康复。

examples.src: The police recovered the stolen car.
examples.dst: 警方找回了被盗的汽车。

examples.src: The economy is beginning to recover.
examples.dst: 经济开始复苏。

confuse.diff: recover 是动词；recovery 是名词，指康复。

examples.src: Use a funnel to pour the oil into the bottle.
examples.dst: 用漏斗把油倒进瓶子里。

examples.src: Smoke rose from the ship's funnel.
examples.dst: 烟从轮船的烟囱里冒出来。

examples.src: The crowd was funnelled through a narrow gate.
examples.dst: 人群被引导着通过一道窄门。

confuse.diff: funnel 指漏斗；fennel 指茴香。

means: 漏斗网蜘蛛（澳大利亚毒蛛）

examples.src: The funnelweb spider is one of the most dangerous spiders in Australia.
examples.dst: 漏斗网蜘蛛是澳大利亚最危险的蜘蛛之一。

examples.src: He was bitten by a funnelweb spider in the garden.
examples.dst: 他在花园里被一只漏斗网蜘蛛咬了。

examples.src: Anti-venom was developed for funnelweb spider bites.
examples.dst: 人们研制出了针对漏斗网蜘蛛咬伤的抗毒血清。

examples.src: A thief snatched her bag and ran away.
examples.dst: 一个小偷抢了她的包就跑了。

examples.src: He snatched a quick lunch between meetings.
examples.dst: 他在会议间隙匆匆吃了午饭。

examples.src: We heard snatches of music from the next room.
examples.dst: 我们听到隔壁房间传来断断续续的音乐。

confuse.diff: snatch 指抓取；snack 指小吃。

examples.src: She was sitting amongst her friends.
examples.dst: 她坐在朋友们中间。

examples.src: The money was shared amongst the workers.
examples.dst: 这笔钱在工人们之间分配。

examples.src: He is popular amongst the students.
examples.dst: 他在学生中很受欢迎。

confuse.diff: amongst 与 among 意思相同，amongst 更偏英式书面语。

examples.src: Add a little vinegar to the salad.
examples.dst: 在沙拉里加一点醋。

examples.src: Vinegar can be used to clean windows.
examples.dst: 醋可以用来擦窗户。

examples.src: The soup tastes too much of vinegar.
examples.dst: 这汤醋味太重了。

means: 失去知觉的；无意识的；未觉察的

examples.src: The injured man was unconscious when the ambulance arrived.
examples.dst: 救护车到达时，伤者已失去知觉。

examples.src: She was unconscious of the danger.
examples.dst: 她没有意识到危险。

examples.src: He made an unconscious gesture with his hand.
examples.dst: 他无意识地做了个手势。

confuse.diff: unconscious 指失去知觉；unconscientious 指不认真的。

examples.src: Bees pollinate many kinds of flowers.
examples.dst: 蜜蜂为许多种花传粉。

examples.src: Farmers need insects to pollinate their crops.
examples.dst: 农民需要昆虫为庄稼授粉。

examples.src: Some plants are pollinated by the wind.
examples.dst: 有些植物靠风传粉。

confuse.diff: pollinate 指传粉；pollute 指污染。

examples.src: Bees are important pollinators.
examples.dst: 蜜蜂是重要的传粉者。

examples.src: Bats act as pollinators for some night flowers.
examples.dst: 蝙蝠为一些夜间开放的花传粉。

examples.src: The number of pollinators is falling in many places.
examples.dst: 许多地方的传粉昆虫数量在下降。

confuse.diff: pollinator 是名词，指传粉者；pollinate 是动词，指传粉。

examples.src: The children played in the courtyard.
examples.dst: 孩子们在院子里玩耍。

examples.src: The old house has a quiet courtyard in the middle.
examples.dst: 这座老房子中间有一个安静的庭院。

examples.src: We had dinner in the courtyard on summer nights.
examples.dst: 夏天的夜晚，我们在院子里吃晚饭。

examples.src: She watered the flowers on the balcony.
examples.dst: 她给阳台上的花浇水。

examples.src: We sat on the balcony and watched the sunset.
examples.dst: 我们坐在阳台上看日落。

examples.src: Our seats are in the balcony of the theatre.
examples.dst: 我们的座位在剧院的楼座上。

means: 外来的；异国情调的；奇异的

examples.src: The garden is full of exotic plants.
examples.dst: 花园里满是来自异国的植物。

examples.src: She loves exotic food from distant lands.
examples.dst: 她喜欢来自遥远国度的异国美食。

examples.src: They spent their holiday on an exotic island.
examples.dst: 他们在一座充满异国情调的岛上度假。

confuse.diff: exotic 指异国的；erotic 指色情的，不要混淆。

examples.src: The castle dates back to the 12th century.
examples.dst: 这座城堡可追溯到十二世纪。

examples.src: This tradition dates back to ancient times.
examples.dst: 这一传统可追溯到古代。

examples.src: The custom dates back to the Tang Dynasty.
examples.dst: 这个习俗始于唐朝。

examples.src: We could hear distant thunder.
examples.dst: 我们听到了远处的雷声。

examples.src: He is a distant relative of mine.
examples.dst: 他是我的远亲。

examples.src: She became cold and distant after the argument.
examples.dst: 争吵之后，她变得冷淡疏远。

confuse.diff: distant 是形容词；distance 是名词，指距离。

examples.src: The shop sells a wide range of goods.
examples.dst: 这家商店出售各种商品。

examples.src: Goods are delivered by train to the north.
examples.dst: 货物通过火车运往北方。

examples.src: They imported goods from overseas.
examples.dst: 他们从海外进口货物。

confuse.diff: goods 指商品；good 指好的。

means: 规模；刻度；比例尺；鳞片；秤

examples.src: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
examples.dst: 这个项目的规模让所有人吃惊。

examples.src: The map is drawn on a scale of 1 to 10,000.
examples.dst: 这张地图的比例尺是一比一万。

examples.src: They scaled the mountain in three days.
examples.dst: 他们用三天时间攀上了这座山。

confuse.diff: scale 指规模或刻度；scare 指惊吓。

examples.src: There was a conflict between the two neighbours.
examples.dst: 两位邻居之间发生了争执。

examples.src: The meeting time conflicts with my class.
examples.dst: 会议时间与我的课程冲突。

examples.src: The conflict ended after months of talks.
examples.dst: 经过数月的谈判，冲突结束了。

confuse.diff: conflict 指冲突、矛盾；confront 指面对、对抗。

examples.src: The missionary spent thirty years in Africa.
examples.dst: 这位传教士在非洲度过了三十年。

examples.src: Missionaries built schools and hospitals in the region.
examples.dst: 传教士在这个地区建了学校和医院。

examples.src: He did missionary work in a small village.
examples.dst: 他在一个小村庄里从事传教工作。

confuse.diff: missionary 指传教士；mission 指使命或任务。

means: 殷染维尔（人名，法国传教士，将植物带回欧洲）

examples.src: D’Incaville was a French missionary who loved plants.
examples.dst: 殷染维尔是一位热爱植物的法国传教士。

examples.src: D’Incaville sent seeds from China to France.
examples.dst: 殷染维尔把种子从中国寄回了法国。

examples.src: We read about d’Incaville in our English textbook.
examples.dst: 我们在英语课本里读到了殷染维尔。

examples.src: He endeavoured to finish the work on time.
examples.dst: 他努力按时完成工作。

examples.src: We admire her endeavour to help the poor.
examples.dst: 我们钦佩她为帮助穷人所做的努力。

examples.src: Scientists continue their endeavours to find a cure.
examples.dst: 科学家们继续努力寻找治疗方法。

confuse.diff: endeavour 是英式拼写；endeavor 是美式拼写。

examples.src: The ship dropped anchor near the island.
examples.dst: 船在岛附近抛了锚。

examples.src: She works as a news anchor on TV.
examples.dst: 她在电视台担任新闻主播。

examples.src: The tent was anchored with heavy stones.
examples.dst: 帐篷用大石头固定住了。

confuse.diff: anchor 指锚；anger 指愤怒。

means: 紧的；紧密的；紧张的；严格的

examples.src: These shoes are too tight for me.
examples.dst: 这双鞋我穿太紧了。

examples.src: Hold the rope tight.
examples.dst: 抓紧绳子。

examples.src: We have a tight schedule this week.
examples.dst: 我们这周日程很紧。

confuse.diff: tight 指紧的；tide 指潮汐。

examples.src: He sealed the envelope and mailed it.
examples.dst: 他封好信封并寄了出去。

examples.src: A seal swam near the boat.
examples.dst: 一只海豹在船边游过。

examples.src: The document carries the official seal.
examples.dst: 这份文件盖有官方印章。

confuse.diff: seal 指密封或海豹；sail 指航行。

examples.src: Keep the food in a clean container.
examples.dst: 把食物放在干净的容器里。

examples.src: Goods are shipped in large containers.
examples.dst: 货物用大集装箱运输。

examples.src: The plastic container can hold two litres of water.
examples.dst: 这个塑料容器能装两升水。

confuse.diff: container 是名词，指容器；contain 是动词，指包含。

means: 沃德箱（19世纪运送活植物的密封玻璃箱）

examples.src: The Wardian case helped plants survive long sea voyages.
examples.dst: 沃德箱帮助植物熬过了漫长的海上航行。

examples.src: Tea plants were carried to India in Wardian cases.
examples.dst: 茶树被装在沃德箱里运到了印度。

examples.src: The Wardian case was a kind of glass box.
examples.dst: 沃德箱是一种玻璃箱。

examples.src: There are restrictions on the use of mobile phones in class.
examples.dst: 课堂上对手机的使用有限制。

examples.src: The government put restrictions on imports.
examples.dst: 政府对进口实行了限制。

examples.src: Age is no restriction to learning.
examples.dst: 年龄不是学习的限制。

confuse.diff: restriction 指限制规定；restraint 指克制或约束。

examples.src: She speaks English with great fluency.
examples.dst: 她英语说得非常流利。

examples.src: Reading aloud can improve your fluency.
examples.dst: 朗读可以提高你的流利程度。

examples.src: His fluency in French impressed the interviewer.
examples.dst: 他流利的法语给面试官留下了深刻印象。

confuse.diff: fluency 是名词；fluent 是形容词，指流利的。

examples.src: He shaves every morning before work.
examples.dst: 他每天早上上班前刮胡子。

examples.src: She shaved a little off the board.
examples.dst: 她从木板上削掉了一点。

examples.src: I need a shave before the interview.
examples.dst: 面试前我得刮个脸。

confuse.diff: shave 指剃或削；shove 指推搡。

examples.src: A thunderstorm is expected this evening.
examples.dst: 预计今晚有雷雨。

examples.src: We stayed indoors during the thunderstorm.
examples.dst: 雷雨期间我们待在室内。

examples.src: The thunderstorm knocked out the power.
examples.dst: 雷暴造成了停电。

examples.src: The pirates attacked the ship and took the gold.
examples.dst: 海盗袭击了这艘船并抢走了黄金。

examples.src: It is illegal to buy pirate copies of films.
examples.dst: 购买盗版电影是违法的。

examples.src: Children love stories about pirates and treasure.
examples.dst: 孩子们喜欢关于海盗和宝藏的故事。

confuse.diff: pirate 指海盗；pilot 指飞行员或领航员。

means: 呼吁；恳求；有吸引力；上诉

examples.src: The police appealed for witnesses.
examples.dst: 警方呼吁目击者提供线索。

examples.src: The film has a wide appeal to teenagers.
examples.dst: 这部电影对青少年很有吸引力。

examples.src: He appealed against the court's decision.
examples.dst: 他对法院的判决提出了上诉。

confuse.diff: appeal 指呼吁或吸引；appear 指出现。

means: 吸引；对……有吸引力；向……呼吁

examples.src: The idea of travelling alone appeals to me.
examples.dst: 独自旅行的想法对我很有吸引力。

examples.src: The speaker appealed to the crowd to stay calm.
examples.dst: 演讲者呼吁人群保持冷静。

examples.src: Cartoons appeal to both children and adults.
examples.dst: 卡通片对孩子和成年人都有吸引力。

examples.src: The dove is a symbol of peace.
examples.dst: 鸽子是和平的象征。

examples.src: A white dove landed on the roof.
examples.dst: 一只白鸽落在屋顶上。

examples.src: Children fed the doves in the square.
examples.dst: 孩子们在广场上喂鸽子。

confuse.diff: dove 指鸽子；dive 指潜水或跳水。

examples.src: The botanist discovered a new kind of orchid.
examples.dst: 这位植物学家发现了一种新的兰花。

examples.src: Botanists study how plants grow.
examples.dst: 植物学家研究植物如何生长。

examples.src: She dreams of becoming a botanist.
examples.dst: 她梦想成为一名植物学家。

confuse.diff: botanist 指植物学家；botany 指植物学。

examples.src: Chrysanthemums bloom in autumn.
examples.dst: 菊花在秋天开放。

examples.src: We drank chrysanthemum tea at the festival.
examples.dst: 节日里我们喝了菊花茶。

examples.src: The garden was full of yellow chrysanthemums.
examples.dst: 花园里开满了黄色的菊花。

examples.src: Grandma cooked rice porridge with red dates.
examples.dst: 奶奶用红枣煮了粥。

examples.src: Red dates are sweet and good for health.
examples.dst: 红枣又甜又有益健康。

examples.src: He put some red dates in the tea.
examples.dst: 他在茶里放了几颗红枣。

examples.src: Please lower your voice in the library.
examples.dst: 在图书馆请降低音量。

examples.src: They lowered the flag at sunset.
examples.dst: 日落时他们降下了旗帜。

examples.src: The shop lowered its prices for the holiday.
examples.dst: 商店在假日期间降低了价格。

confuse.diff: lower 指降低；lover 指爱人或爱好者。

examples.src: The old man has a long white beard.
examples.dst: 这位老人留着长长的白胡子。

examples.src: He decided to grow a beard.
examples.dst: 他决定留胡子。

examples.src: Santa Claus has a thick beard.
examples.dst: 圣诞老人有浓密的胡须。

confuse.diff: beard 指胡须；board 指木板或董事会。

examples.src: These apples are ripe and sweet.
examples.dst: 这些苹果熟了，很甜。

examples.src: The time is ripe for change.
examples.dst: 改变的时机已经成熟。

examples.src: Wait until the fruit is ripe before picking it.
examples.dst: 等水果成熟了再摘。

confuse.diff: ripe 指成熟的；rip 指撕开。

examples.src: Irrigation is vital for farming in dry areas.
examples.dst: 在干旱地区，灌溉对农业至关重要。

examples.src: The irrigation system brings water to the fields.
examples.dst: 灌溉系统把水引到田里。

examples.src: Ancient Egyptians built irrigation channels along the Nile.
examples.dst: 古埃及人沿尼罗河修建了灌溉渠。

confuse.diff: irrigation 指灌溉；irritation 指恼怒或刺激。

examples.src: He spent the morning pulling weeds in the garden.
examples.dst: 他一上午都在花园里拔草。

examples.src: Weeds grow fast after the rain.
examples.dst: 雨后杂草长得很快。

examples.src: She weeded the flower beds.
examples.dst: 她给花坛除了草。

confuse.diff: weed 指杂草；wheat 指小麦。

examples.src: The hunter threw his spear at the deer.
examples.dst: 猎人向鹿掷出了长矛。

examples.src: He speared a piece of meat with his fork.
examples.dst: 他用叉子叉起一块肉。

examples.src: Early people used spears to catch fish.
examples.dst: 早期的人用长矛捕鱼。

confuse.diff: spear 指矛；sphere 指球体或领域。

examples.src: He tied the box with a piece of string.
examples.dst: 他用一根细绳把盒子捆好。

examples.src: The guitar has six strings.
examples.dst: 这把吉他有六根弦。

examples.src: A string of bad luck made him give up.
examples.dst: 一连串的坏运气使他放弃了。

confuse.diff: string 指绳线；strain 指拉紧或压力。

examples.src: He dug a hole with a spade.
examples.dst: 他用铁锹挖了一个坑。

examples.src: Children played with a bucket and spade on the beach.
examples.dst: 孩子们在海滩上玩小桶和小铲。

examples.src: She played the ace of spades.
examples.dst: 她打出了黑桃A。

confuse.diff: spade 指铁锹；space 指空间或太空。

examples.src: The match was postponed because of rain.
examples.dst: 比赛因下雨而推迟。

examples.src: We had to postpone our trip until next month.
examples.dst: 我们不得不把旅行推迟到下个月。

examples.src: Don't postpone what you can do today.
examples.dst: 今天能做的事不要拖延。

confuse.diff: postpone 指推迟到以后；cancel 指取消。

examples.src: The pyramids in Egypt are thousands of years old.
examples.dst: 埃及的金字塔已有数千年历史。

examples.src: The students built a pyramid from paper.
examples.dst: 学生们用纸做了一座金字塔。

examples.src: The company has a pyramid structure.
examples.dst: 这家公司采用金字塔式的结构。

examples.src: The monument honours the soldiers who died in the war.
examples.dst: 这座纪念碑是为了纪念在战争中牺牲的士兵。

examples.src: We visited the national monument in the capital.
examples.dst: 我们参观了首都的国家纪念碑。

examples.src: The Great Wall is a monument to human effort.
examples.dst: 长城是人类努力的丰碑。

confuse.diff: monument 指纪念碑；moment 指片刻。

examples.src: The pitcher plant catches insects in its jug-like leaves.
examples.dst: 猪笼草用像壶一样的叶子捕捉昆虫。

examples.src: We saw a pitcher plant in the tropical garden.
examples.dst: 我们在热带花园里看到了一株猪笼草。

examples.src: A pitcher plant gets nutrients from the insects it traps.
examples.dst: 猪笼草从捕获的昆虫身上获取养分。

means: 阿诺尔德大花（一种巨型寄生花，常拼作 Rafflesia arnoldii）

examples.src: Raffesia arnoldii is the largest flower in the world.
examples.dst: 阿诺尔德大花是世界上最大的花。

examples.src: The flower of Raffesia arnoldii smells like rotten meat.
examples.dst: 阿诺尔德大花的花闻起来像腐肉。

examples.src: Tourists travel to Southeast Asia to see Raffesia arnoldii.
examples.dst: 游客前往东南亚观赏阿诺尔德大花。

examples.src: The apples began to rot in the box.
examples.dst: 苹果在箱子里开始腐烂。

examples.src: Wood will rot if it stays wet.
examples.dst: 木头一直潮湿就会腐朽。

examples.src: Too many sweets will rot your teeth.
examples.dst: 吃太多糖会蛀牙。

confuse.diff: rot 指腐烂；rod 指杆。

examples.src: Birds evolved from dinosaurs.
examples.dst: 鸟类是从恐龙进化而来的。

examples.src: The company has evolved into a global business.
examples.dst: 这家公司已发展成一家全球性企业。

examples.src: Languages evolve over time.
examples.dst: 语言随着时间不断演变。

confuse.diff: evolve 指进化；involve 指涉及。

examples.src: Darwin's theory of evolution changed biology.
examples.dst: 达尔文的进化论改变了生物学。

examples.src: The evolution of the mobile phone has been rapid.
examples.dst: 手机的发展十分迅速。

examples.src: The book explains the evolution of the human brain.
examples.dst: 这本书解释了人类大脑的进化。

confuse.diff: evolution 指渐进的进化；revolution 指革命或剧变。

examples.src: Bees collect nectar from flowers.
examples.dst: 蜜蜂从花中采集花蜜。

examples.src: Hummingbirds feed on nectar.
examples.dst: 蜂鸟以花蜜为食。

examples.src: The juice tasted like nectar on a hot day.
examples.dst: 大热天里，这果汁喝起来像甘露一样。

confuse.diff: nectar 指花蜜；neckerchief 指围脖或颈巾。

examples.src: Please attach a photo to your application.
examples.dst: 请在申请表上附一张照片。

examples.src: She attached a note to the gift.
examples.dst: 她在礼物上附了一张便条。

examples.src: He is deeply attached to his hometown.
examples.dst: 他对家乡眷恋很深。

confuse.diff: attach 指附上；attack 指攻击。

examples.src: A wasp stung me on the arm.
examples.dst: 一只黄蜂蜇了我的胳膊。

examples.src: Wasps built a nest under the roof.
examples.dst: 黄蜂在屋檐下筑了一个巢。

examples.src: Some wasps help pollinate flowers.
examples.dst: 有些黄蜂能帮助花传粉。

confuse.diff: wasp 指黄蜂；wisp 指一缕或一小束。

examples.src: A shiny green beetle crawled across the leaf.
examples.dst: 一只闪亮的绿色甲虫爬过叶子。

examples.src: Beetles are the largest group of insects.
examples.dst: 甲虫是昆虫中最大的类群。

examples.src: Some beetles pollinate flowers.
examples.dst: 有些甲虫会为花传粉。

confuse.diff: beetle 指甲虫；beaker 指烧杯。

examples.src: Bats fly out of the cave at night.
examples.dst: 蝙蝠在夜里飞出洞穴。

examples.src: He hit the ball with a baseball bat.
examples.dst: 他用棒球棒击中了球。

examples.src: She bats first in our team.
examples.dst: 在我们队里她第一个击球。

confuse.diff: bat 指蝙蝠或球棒；bad 指坏的。

examples.src: Moths are attracted to light.
examples.dst: 飞蛾会被光吸引。

examples.src: A moth had eaten a hole in my sweater.
examples.dst: 一只蛀虫在我的毛衣上咬出了一个洞。

examples.src: Many moths fly at night.
examples.dst: 许多蛾子夜间飞行。

confuse.diff: moth 指蛾；mouth 指嘴。

examples.src: The humming-bird hovered in front of the flower.
examples.dst: 蜂鸟悬停在花前。

examples.src: A humming-bird beats its wings very fast.
examples.dst: 蜂鸟扇动翅膀的速度非常快。

examples.src: Humming-birds feed on nectar.
examples.dst: 蜂鸟以花蜜为食。

means: 典型的；有代表性的；特有的

examples.src: This is a typical English breakfast.
examples.dst: 这是一份典型的英式早餐。

examples.src: It is typical of him to be late.
examples.dst: 他总是迟到，这很像他的作风。

examples.src: A typical day begins with a morning run.
examples.dst: 典型的一天从晨跑开始。

confuse.diff: typical 指典型的；topical 指时事的。

examples.src: The rose has soft red petals.
examples.dst: 这朵玫瑰有柔软的红色花瓣。

examples.src: Petals fell from the cherry tree like snow.
examples.dst: 樱花花瓣像雪一样从树上飘落。

examples.src: The flower has five white petals.
examples.dst: 这朵花有五片白色花瓣。

confuse.diff: petal 指花瓣；pedal 指踏板。

examples.src: Squeeze the toothpaste out of the tube.
examples.dst: 把牙膏从软管里挤出来。

examples.src: Air passes through a tube into the lungs.
examples.dst: 空气通过一根管子进入肺部。

examples.src: We took the tube to the museum in London.
examples.dst: 我们乘地铁去了伦敦的博物馆。

confuse.diff: tube 指管；tub 指桶或浴缸。

means: 精致的；易损的；微妙的；清淡的

examples.src: The cup is made of delicate china.
examples.dst: 这个杯子是用精细的瓷做成的。

examples.src: The baby has delicate skin.
examples.dst: 这个婴儿的皮肤很娇嫩。

examples.src: It is a delicate situation, so be careful.
examples.dst: 这是个微妙的局面，所以要小心。

confuse.diff: delicate 指精致的；delicious 指美味的。

examples.src: The garden is full of fragrant flowers.
examples.dst: 花园里满是芳香的花朵。

examples.src: A fragrant smell came from the kitchen.
examples.dst: 厨房里飘出一股香味。

examples.src: She likes fragrant tea.
examples.dst: 她喜欢香气浓郁的茶。

confuse.diff: fragrant 指芳香的；fragile 指易碎的。

examples.src: Daisies grew all over the lawn.
examples.dst: 草坪上到处长着雏菊。

examples.src: She made a crown of daisies.
examples.dst: 她用雏菊编了一个花冠。

examples.src: The little girl picked a daisy for her mother.
examples.dst: 小女孩摘了一朵雏菊送给妈妈。

examples.src: There was a strange odour in the room.
examples.dst: 房间里有一股奇怪的气味。

examples.src: The flower gives off a sweet odour.
examples.dst: 这朵花散发出甜甜的香气。

examples.src: She wrinkled her nose at the odour of the rotten egg.
examples.dst: 闻到臭鸡蛋的味道，她皱起了鼻子。

confuse.diff: odour 是英式拼写；odor 是美式拼写。

examples.src: Pure water is clear and odourless.
examples.dst: 纯净水清澈无味。

examples.src: The gas is colourless and odourless.
examples.dst: 这种气体无色无味。

examples.src: They use an odourless paint in the baby's room.
examples.dst: 他们在婴儿房里使用无味油漆。

confuse.diff: odourless 是形容词，意为无气味的；odour 是名词，指气味。

examples.src: The flower gives out a sweet smell.
examples.dst: 这朵花散发出甜美的香味。

examples.src: The teacher gave out the test papers.
examples.dst: 老师分发了试卷。

examples.src: Our food supplies gave out after a week.
examples.dst: 一周后我们的食物耗尽了。

confuse.diff: give out 指发出或分发；give up 指放弃。

means: 乏味的；暗淡的；迟钝的；钝的

examples.src: The lecture was dull and long.
examples.dst: 这场讲座又长又乏味。

examples.src: It was a dull, grey day.
examples.dst: 那是阴沉灰暗的一天。

examples.src: The knife is too dull to cut anything.
examples.dst: 这把刀太钝了，什么都切不动。

confuse.diff: dull 指乏味的；doll 指玩偶。

examples.src: The old room smelled musty.
examples.dst: 这间旧屋子有股霉味。

examples.src: The books in the cellar were musty.
examples.dst: 地窖里的书发霉了。

examples.src: Open the windows to get rid of the musty smell.
examples.dst: 打开窗户去除霉味。

confuse.diff: musty 指发霉的；dusty 指满是灰尘的。

examples.src: The tea has a fruity flavour.
examples.dst: 这种茶有水果的味道。

examples.src: She likes fruity perfume.
examples.dst: 她喜欢果香味的香水。

examples.src: The wine smells fruity.
examples.dst: 这种酒闻起来有果香。

confuse.diff: fruity 指水果味的；fruitful 指富有成效的。

examples.src: A huge billboard stood beside the road.
examples.dst: 路边立着一块巨大的广告牌。

examples.src: The new film was advertised on billboards.
examples.dst: 新电影在广告牌上做了宣传。

examples.src: The billboard caught everyone's eye.
examples.dst: 这块广告牌吸引了每个人的目光。

confuse.diff: billboard 指广告牌；blackboard 指黑板。

means: 随意的；非正式的；偶然的

examples.src: He wore casual clothes to the party.
examples.dst: 他穿着休闲服装去参加聚会。

examples.src: It was just a casual remark.
examples.dst: 那只是随口说的一句话。

examples.src: We had a casual chat over coffee.
examples.dst: 我们喝着咖啡随意聊了聊。

confuse.diff: casual 指随意的；causal 指因果的。

examples.src: The factory makes garments for export.
examples.dst: 这家工厂生产出口服装。

examples.src: She hung the garment on a hanger.
examples.dst: 她把衣服挂在衣架上。

examples.src: Wool garments keep you warm in winter.
examples.dst: 羊毛衣服能让你冬天保暖。

confuse.diff: garment 指衣服；garage 指车库。

examples.src: The magician turned a stick into a flower.
examples.dst: 魔术师把一根棍子变成了一朵花。

examples.src: They turned the old barn into a studio.
examples.dst: 他们把旧谷仓改成了工作室。

examples.src: Heat turns ice into water.
examples.dst: 热量能把冰变成水。

examples.src: The advertiser paid a lot for a TV slot.
examples.dst: 广告客户花了很多钱买电视广告时段。

examples.src: Advertisers try to attract young customers.
examples.dst: 广告商努力吸引年轻顾客。

examples.src: The newspaper depends on advertisers for income.
examples.dst: 这家报纸靠广告客户获得收入。

confuse.diff: advertiser 指登广告的人或公司；advertisement 指广告本身。

means: 广告（英式口语，advertisement 的缩写）

examples.src: I saw an advert for a new phone on TV.
examples.dst: 我在电视上看到了一款新手机的广告。

examples.src: She answered an advert in the newspaper.
examples.dst: 她回应了报纸上的一则广告。

examples.src: The advert made everyone laugh.
examples.dst: 这则广告让每个人都笑了。

confuse.diff: advert 是 advertisement 的口语缩写，指广告；avert 指避免、转移。

examples.src: Please inform me of any changes.
examples.dst: 如有任何变动请通知我。

examples.src: The school informed parents about the trip.
examples.dst: 学校把旅行的事通知了家长。

examples.src: He informed the police of the theft.
examples.dst: 他向警方报告了盗窃案。

confuse.diff: inform 指告知；perform 指表演或执行。

examples.src: She joined the school music association.
examples.dst: 她加入了学校的音乐协会。

examples.src: There is a close association between diet and health.
examples.dst: 饮食和健康关系密切。

examples.src: The song has happy associations for me.
examples.dst: 这首歌让我联想到很多快乐的事。

confuse.diff: association 指协会或联系；assistance 指帮助。

examples.src: Our target is to finish the work by Friday.
examples.dst: 我们的目标是在周五前完成工作。

examples.src: The arrow hit the centre of the target.
examples.dst: 箭射中了靶心。

examples.src: The advert targets young people.
examples.dst: 这则广告以年轻人为对象。

confuse.diff: target 指目标；tarnish 指使失去光泽。

examples.src: All the books fit into one box.
examples.dst: 所有的书都装得进一个箱子。

examples.src: She quickly fitted into the new class.
examples.dst: 她很快融入了新班级。

examples.src: The meeting doesn't fit into my schedule.
examples.dst: 这个会议与我的日程不合。

examples.src: Trust is the basis of friendship.
examples.dst: 信任是友谊的基础。

examples.src: The decision was made on the basis of the facts.
examples.dst: 这个决定是根据事实做出的。

examples.src: We meet on a regular basis.
examples.dst: 我们定期见面。

confuse.diff: basis 指抽象的基础或依据；base 指实体的底部或基地。

examples.src: She learned a new swimming technique.
examples.dst: 她学会了一种新的游泳技巧。

examples.src: The artist uses an old painting technique.
examples.dst: 这位艺术家使用一种古老的绘画技法。

examples.src: Good study techniques save time.
examples.dst: 好的学习方法能节省时间。

confuse.diff: technique 指具体的技巧；technology 指科技。

examples.src: We walked down a quiet country lane.
examples.dst: 我们沿着一条安静的乡间小路走。

examples.src: The motorway has three lanes in each direction.
examples.dst: 这条高速公路每个方向有三条车道。

examples.src: The swimmer in lane four won the race.
examples.dst: 四号泳道的选手赢得了比赛。

confuse.diff: lane 指小路或车道；line 指线或队伍。

means: 特征；特点；专题报道；面貌

examples.src: The phone has many useful features.
examples.dst: 这款手机有很多实用的功能。

examples.src: The film features a famous young actor.
examples.dst: 这部电影由一位著名的年轻演员主演。

examples.src: The newspaper ran a feature on the town.
examples.dst: 报纸刊登了一篇关于这个小镇的专题报道。

confuse.diff: feature 指特征；future 指未来。

examples.src: He has a guilty conscience about the lie.
examples.dst: 他因为这个谎言而感到内疚。

examples.src: A good doctor follows his conscience.
examples.dst: 好医生遵从自己的良知。

examples.src: She could not in all conscience refuse to help.
examples.dst: 凭良心说，她不能拒绝帮忙。

confuse.diff: conscience 指良心；conscious 指有意识的。

means: 值得的；有价值的；应得的

examples.src: She is worthy of the prize.
examples.dst: 她配得上这个奖。

examples.src: It is a worthy cause that deserves support.
examples.dst: 这是一项值得支持的事业。

examples.src: The book is worthy of attention.
examples.dst: 这本书值得关注。

confuse.diff: worthy 后接 of；worth 后直接接名词或动名词。

examples.src: He works for a large oil corporation.
examples.dst: 他在一家大型石油公司工作。

examples.src: The corporation plans to open new factories.
examples.dst: 这家公司计划开设新工厂。

examples.src: The British Broadcasting Corporation is known as the BBC.
